# Graduate Business Finance Consultant

## Job Description

Location: Central London

Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Salary: £30,000-£35,000 per annum + Performance Bonus

Working Pattern: Monday-Friday Hybrid options available

The Opportunity 

We are seeking a commercially minded Graduate Business Finance Advisor to join our growing financial consultancy team, supporting UK businesses with their funding requirements and commercial decision-making.

This entry-level, client-facing position is ideal for graduates interested in understanding business operations, analysing financial information and helping businesses explore practical funding solutions.

You will work alongside experienced finance professionals, supporting commercial clients, company directors and business owners with their financing requirements.

Structured onboarding, professional development and exposure to multiple industries will help you build a successful career in commercial finance.

Previous experience is not essential, although strong analytical skills, commercial awareness and a willingness to learn are important.

What You'll Be Doing 

As a Graduate Business Finance Advisor, you will support client enquiries, financial assessments and commercial finance applications under appropriate supervision.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Communicating with business owners, directors and commercial clients.
- Understanding business models, financial circumstances and commercial objectives.
- Identifying clients' funding requirements and gathering relevant information.
- Reviewing financial statements, management accounts and cash-flow information.
- Supporting senior colleagues in assessing business performance and funding options.
- Providing general information about commercial finance products and application processes.
- Supporting businesses seeking finance for expansion, equipment, working capital and acquisitions.
- Researching commercial loans, asset finance, invoice finance and other funding solutions.
- Preparing client summaries, financial reports and preliminary finance proposals.
- Liaising with lenders, finance providers and internal departments.
- Gathering documentation required for commercial finance applications.
- Comparing commercial finance terms and preparing information for client discussions.
- Monitoring application progress and maintaining accurate client records.
- Following compliance, confidentiality and data-protection procedures.
- Building professional relationships with business clients.
- Keeping informed about developments within the UK commercial finance market.

As your experience develops, you will gradually take on greater responsibility for client enquiries, financial assessments and commercial finance cases.

What We're Looking For 

We welcome ambitious graduates with strong communication skills, commercial awareness and an interest in financial services.

Suitable degree disciplines include:

Finance Accounting Economics Business Management Banking Financial Analysis Corporate Finance Financial Consultancy

Essential Requirements 

- A degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, banking or a related discipline.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Basic understanding of financial statements, cash flow and business performance.
- Confidence communicating with business owners and senior professionals.
- Good commercial judgement and problem-solving abilities.
- Level 4 CPD certification for financial advisers.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to explain financial information clearly and professionally.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Professional, client-focused approach.
- Willingness to develop commercial finance knowledge.
- Interest in building a long-term career within financial services.

Previous experience through internships, university placements, banking, accountancy or financial services would be advantageous but is not essential.

What We Offer 

This position combines competitive graduate earning potential with professional development and long-term career opportunities.

Benefits include:

- £30,000-£35,000 starting salary, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.
- Performance-related bonus scheme.
- Additional incentives linked to individual and team performance.
- Structured onboarding and professional training.
- Exposure to businesses across multiple industries.
- Clear progression into senior advisory and management positions.
- Hybrid working opportunities following successful onboarding.
- Company pension.
- Generous annual leave allowance.
- Regular performance and salary reviews.

Career Progression 

We aim to develop graduates into confident commercial finance professionals with strong analytical, financial and client relationship skills.

As your experience grows, you will have opportunities to manage more complex finance enquiries, develop commercial relationships and take on greater responsibilities.

Typical career pathway:

Graduate Business Finance Advisor Business Finance Advisor Senior Business Finance Advisor Commercial Finance Manager Head of Business Finance

Progression depends on individual performance, professional competence and business requirements.

Important Scope of the Role 

This is a business and commercial finance position, not an investment-advisory or personal wealth-management role.

The successful candidate must operate within the services and permissions applicable to Westminster Commercial Finance and must not undertake regulated activities unless appropriately authorised or exempt.

Graduates will receive supervision and professional guidance while developing their experience.

Are you a recent graduate looking to establish a career in commercial finance?

If you enjoy working with numbers, understanding businesses and communicating with professionals, this opportunity offers a foundation for career development within finance, consultancy and commercial strategy.

We welcome applications from ambitious graduates with strong analytical skills, commercial awareness and the motivation to succeed within the UK financial services sector.

Overview

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.

Our 2027 Trading Operations Analyst Programme (OA) is a 6‑month rotational programme for soon‑to‑be and recent graduates. This programme provides a blend of education, skill building, and exposure to Susquehanna and the financial services industry. It will prepare you for a full‑time position that immediately impacts Susquehanna’s business. Through 4‑week rotations you will have the opportunity to gain exposure to every desk within Trading Operations such as Trade Support, Risk Operations, Stock Loan and Settlements. Once the programme is complete, you will be placed on a fast‑paced desk that directly impacts Susquehanna's performance.

This role is based in the UK; however, the first three months of the programme (September to December 2027) will take place in our Dublin office as part of an immersive graduate training experience. During this time, you will join peers from across Europe for in‑depth learning and hands‑on development before returning to the UK to complete the programme. You will have the necessary support to make this transition smooth and focused on your learning and development.
Our Programme:

As a Trading Operations Analyst you will be exposed to the full life cycle of Susquehanna’s trading activity and develop a fundamental understanding of the industry and trading environment which Susquehanna operates in. Trading Operations work at the intersection of trading, technology, and external counterparties, where you are empowered to develop strong relationships and work on exciting, valuable projects which have real impact and contribute to our success. Working alongside our team you will develop an in‑depth exposure to all the different trading desks and business areas at Susquehanna with each rotation incorporating hands‑on experience and real‑time projects to add value.

If you have a keen interest in the financial markets, collaborating with traders while up‑skilling technically then Trading Operations could be the role for you.
What we're looking for
• Problem Solver: You enjoy solving puzzles and love when you discover a solution to difficult problems. You’re not afraid to discuss ideas and work with others to find the optimal solution.
• Communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with. You enjoy sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts and listening to the views of others.
• Ambitious: You constantly set yourself goals in life and give your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics or another passion you have, you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential.
• Numerical & Logical: When it comes to decision making, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions.
• Curious: You’re eager to find out more about what it’s like to work in the Finance sector, and specifically Trading Operations. Have a passion and identifiable interest in the financial markets and current affairs.
• Soon‑to‑be or recent graduate: Our programme starts in early September 2027.
What's in it for you:
• Education: Susquehanna’s in‑house education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. You will attend regular seminars to learn about in‑house business, products, and tech (Excel, SQL, Python etc.).
• Support: You will be assigned a mentor from our trading operations team for each of your rotations. You will also be assigned a buddy who was a previous OA to guide you along the way.
• Real Impact: You will work collaboratively with the technology team and traders on your desk to develop trade ideas and provide real‑time opinions throughout the trading day. You will collaborate on daily tasks and improvements which are key to the ongoing success of the business.
• Culture: Our culture allows employees of every level to thrive. We are not your typical trading firm – the environment is casual, collaborative and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long you’ve been in Susquehanna.

Apply > Recruiter Interview > Interview > Final Interview > Offer

If you would like to read what our Trading Operations Analysts say about working in Susquehanna, check out the Meet Our Team page on our website: https://sig.com/about/team/
Final tip - We hire for this programme on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early.

Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us.
